name: Money & privacy
description: Correctness of money handling and care of personal data: float amounts, unspecified rounding, mixed currencies, non-idempotent financial writes, missing audit trails, PII in logs and undefined retention. Judged by reading the context's code.

fields.label: Float money
fields.description: Amounts stored, summed, taxed or converted as float, double or plain JS number arithmetic.

fields.label: Unspecified rounding
fields.description: Money divided, multiplied by a rate or allocated with no explicit rounding mode and scale.

fields.label: Currency mixing
fields.description: Amounts of different or unknown currencies added or compared with no currency field or conversion.

fields.label: Non-idempotent money writes
fields.description: Payment, invoice, posting or payout writes with no idempotency key, unique constraint or dedupe, so a retry writes twice.

fields.label: Unaudited money changes
fields.description: Financial mutations with no who, when and before/after record.

fields.label: PII in logs
fields.description: Personal or financial data written to logs, error reporters or analytics.

fields.label: Undefined retention
fields.description: Stores of personal data or financial documents with no retention or deletion rule anywhere in the repo.

rules.reason: {floatMoney} sites do money in floating point
{piiInLogs} sites write personal data to logs
{auditTrailMissing} financial mutations leave no audit record
{retentionUndefined} data stores have no retention rule

scan.instructions: Judge how the context computes, stores and changes money, and where its personal data goes. Evidence rules - a finding that breaks one is not counted: (1) each finding names file:line, the reachable entry point (route, server action, job, import, webhook) and one sentence on why real amounts or real people's data pass through it; no file:line, no count. (2) Count only shipped code: never tests, fixtures, seeds, demo data, dead code. (3) Before counting, try to refute it: look for the money type, decimal column, idempotency middleware, audit interceptor or log redactor that already covers the site; it counts only if you can point to the file:line where it is configured. (4) One root cause is one finding listing every entry it reaches; a float column is one finding, not one per query that reads it. (5) Never guess what a library does by default: write 'unverified'. (6) Per finding suggest a tier 0-3 and a risk_class (money, data, or secret for exposed credentials) per lens-scan references/triage.md - float money in a ledger write, a non-idempotent payment and PII in logs are tier 0; a missing audit trail on financial mutations is tier 1. (7) A context that touches no amounts and no personal data is not applicable, with a one-line reason; 0 means judged and clean. Doubtful sites go under 'unconfirmed' and never raise a count. Fields: floatMoney - amounts in FLOAT, REAL or double precision columns, C# double or float, Java double, Python float, or JS number arithmetic on amounts (sum, tax, FX) with no integer minor units or decimal library; safe: integer cents, NUMERIC/DECIMAL columns, C# decimal, Python Decimal, BigDecimal, decimal.js, dinero.js, big.js. Display-only formatting is not a finding. roundingUnspecified - division, rate multiplication or allocation with no explicit mode and scale (Math.round or toFixed on currency, Math.Round with the default MidpointRounding, Decimal without quantize, BigDecimal without a RoundingMode). currencyMixing - amounts summed or compared across rows or sources with no currency column beside the amount or no conversion step. nonIdempotentWrites - creating payments, invoices, ledger postings or payouts with no idempotency key, unique constraint or dedupe check, so a retry, a double click or a redelivered webhook writes twice. auditTrailMissing - invoice edits, payment status changes, postings or supplier bank-detail changes with no who, when and before/after record (audit table, event log, temporal table, Envers, django-simple-history). piiInLogs - emails, names, IBANs or account numbers, card fragments, tax ids or whole request bodies sent to console, a logger, Sentry or analytics without a redactor. retentionUndefined - per store (table, bucket, log sink) of personal data or financial documents with no TTL, scheduled purge or written policy in the repo; one finding per store, citing where you looked.
